name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-orbinaut
title: Super Mario World Styled Orbinaut
description:
That's an alternative for Zuccha's Orbinaut sprite here, featuring SMW styled graphics as the original sprite features non-SMW styled graphics, so being useful if you want to use the sprite but on a SMW styled hack.

Important Notes:

1. You must need to change the sprite (orbinaut.json and orbinaut_spike_ball.json) for another palette row using CFG Editor, a program included in PIXI files.

The sprite is intended to feature a blue color, so you would need to change it for palette row B, but you can as well change it for another sprite palette row that would fit good with the sprite, as row A (yellow), row C (red) and row D (green).

Don't forget you need to change the palette row for both sprites included, orbinaut.json and orbinaut_spike_ball.json, but if you want you can set different color for head and spike balls sprites (for example, making the orbinaut head gets green and the spike balls get red).

2. Credits aren't necessary, but would get me happy.
